---
title: "Clean data"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load data

```{r}
df_raw      <- haven::read_sas("data_in/datasetup_20260201.sas7bdat")
df_visits_all <- haven::read_sas("../Data/outcomes/outcome_anypsy.sas7bdat")
```

Exclude
- People who died before their parents
- People born before 1971
- People whose 35th birthday is after March 1st, 2025

```{r}
lopnr_died_before_parents <-
  df_raw %>% 
  mutate(age_death = as.numeric((xdeathdate - xbirthdate)/365)) %>% 
  filter(age_death < age_loss) %>% 
  pull(LopNR)

df_excl <-
  df_raw %>%
  # Calculate 25th and 35th birthdays
  mutate(dt_25_birthday = xbirthdate + lubridate::years(25),
         dt_35_birthday = xbirthdate + lubridate::years(35),
         dt_emigration = replace_na(dt_emigration, as.Date("2050-01-01")),
         xdeathdate = replace_na(xdeathdate, as.Date("2050-01-01"))) %>% 
  filter(xbirthdate > as.Date("1971-01-01"),
         xbirthdate < as.Date("2000-03-01"),
         dt_35_birthday < as.Date("2023-01-01"),
         !c(LopNR %in% lopnr_died_before_parents)) %>% 
  # Exclude if only one sibling left in pair
  add_count(fmlink) %>% 
  filter(n > 1) %>% 
  select(-n)
```

Calculate any additional variables and select only relevant ones

```{r}
regex_icd_cat <- "^(798|E[89][0-9]{2}|R96|[V-Y])"

df_sel <-
  df_excl %>% 
  # Did parents die within a year of each other
  mutate(both_died = abs(as.numeric(xdeathdate_moth - xdeathdate_fath)) < 365,
         both_died = replace_na(both_died, 0)) %>% 
  # Which parent died 
  mutate(which_parent = case_when(both_died == 1 ~ "Both",
                                  dt_loss == xdeathdate_fath ~ "Father",
                                  dt_loss == xdeathdate_moth ~ "Mother")) %>% 
  # Was it an unnatural death
  mutate(icd_death = ifelse(which_parent == "Mother" | which_parent == "Both",
                            dia_moth, dia_fath),
         unnatural_death = as.numeric(str_detect(icd_death, regex_icd_cat))) %>%
  # How many person years between death and 35th birthday (end of FU)
  mutate(person_years = lubridate::time_length(lubridate::interval(dt_loss, dt_35_birthday), "year")) %>% 
  select(lopnr = LopNR,
         fam_link = fmlink,
         age_loss, which_parent, unnatural_death, sex,
         person_years,
         dt_birth = xbirthdate,
         dt_25_birthday, dt_35_birthday,
         dt_loss)
```

### Calculate date of first visit 

Create a wide dataset with first date of visit for:

* Each diagnostic outcome (for loop)
* Each planned-unplanned scenario (first two datasets within for loop)
* Each before or after 25 time window (second datasets)

```{r}
df_fu_joined <- select(df_sel, lopnr) 

for(file in list.files("../Data/outcomes")){
  
  # Location of each data file
  data_dir <- paste0("../Data/outcomes/", file)
  # Outcome label
  outcome <- str_extract(data_dir, "(?<=outcome_).+(?=[.])")
  
  df_visits <- 
    # Load data
    haven::read_sas(data_dir) %>% 
    # Keep only needed variables
    rename(dt_visit = starts_with("dt_")) %>% 
    mutate(lopnr = LopNR, 
           dt_visit, 
           planned = ifelse(planned == "", NA, planned),
           visit_unplanned = planned == "2",
           .keep = "none") %>% 
    # Apply exclusion criteria
    filter(lopnr %in% df_sel$lopnr) %>%
    drop_na(dt_visit, planned) %>% 
    # Join with birthday data
    left_join(df_sel %>% select(lopnr, dt_loss, dt_25_birthday, dt_35_birthday),
              by = "lopnr") %>%
    filter(dt_visit > dt_loss,
           dt_visit < dt_35_birthday)
  
  
  df_visits_anytime_all <-
    df_visits %>% 
    select(lopnr, dt_visit) %>% 
    slice_min(dt_visit,
              by = lopnr,
              with_ties = F) %>% 
    mutate(timing_planned = "anytime_all")
  
  df_visits_anytime_unplanned <-
    df_visits %>% 
    filter(visit_unplanned) %>%
    select(lopnr, dt_visit) %>% 
    slice_min(dt_visit, 
              by = lopnr,
              with_ties = F) %>% 
    mutate(timing_planned = "anytime_unplanned")
  
  df_visits_after_25_all <- 
    df_visits %>% 
    filter(dt_visit > dt_25_birthday) %>%
    select(lopnr, dt_visit) %>% 
    slice_min(dt_visit, 
              by = lopnr,
              with_ties = F) %>% 
    mutate(timing_planned = "after_25_all")
    
  df_visits_after_25_unplanned <- 
    df_visits %>% 
    filter(dt_visit > dt_25_birthday,
           visit_unplanned) %>%
    select(lopnr, dt_visit) %>% 
    slice_min(dt_visit, 
              by = lopnr,
              with_ties = F) %>% 
    mutate(timing_planned = "after_25_unplanned")
  
  df_visits_combined <-
    # Combine together
    bind_rows(df_visits_anytime_all, df_visits_anytime_unplanned,
              df_visits_after_25_all, df_visits_after_25_unplanned) %>% 
    # Make wide
    pivot_wider(names_from = timing_planned, values_from = dt_visit) %>%
    # Add label for outcome
    rename_with(~paste0(outcome, "_", .), 
                .cols = -lopnr)
    
  # Join with the rest of the data
  df_fu_joined <- 
    left_join(df_fu_joined, df_visits_combined, by = "lopnr")
}
```

Add variables needed for calculating follow up time (dt_birth, dt_death, dt_emigration)

```{r}
df_fu_full <-
  df_fu_joined %>% 
  left_join(df_raw %>% select(lopnr = LopNR,
                              dt_birth = xbirthdate,
                              dt_emigration,
                              dt_index_death = xdeathdate),
            by = "lopnr") %>% 
  left_join(df_sel %>% select(lopnr, dt_35_birthday),
            by = "lopnr")
```

### Calculate follow-up and outcome binary indicator

Function for calculating follow-up of each psychiatric outcome

```{r}
calculate_fu <- function(dt_var){
  
  # Label for follow-up end variable (e.g fu_dep_after_25_planned)
  fu_var_lab  <- paste0("fu_", dt_var)
  # Label for follow-up 0/1 outcome variable (e.g is_dep_after_25_planned)
  bin_var_lab <- paste0("is_", dt_var)
  
  df_fu <-
    df_fu_full %>% 
    rowwise() %>% 
    # Calculate which came first - diagnosis, emigration, death or 35th birthday
    mutate(fu_start = as.numeric(dt_birth),
           !!fu_var_lab := min(c(!!sym(dt_var), dt_emigration, 
                                 dt_35_birthday,
                                 dt_index_death, as.Date("2023-03-01")),
                                 na.rm = T),
           !!fu_var_lab := as.numeric(!!sym(fu_var_lab))) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    # Calculate diagnosis binary indicator (i.e. FU ends with diagnosis) 
    mutate(!!bin_var_lab := as.numeric(!!sym(fu_var_lab) == as.numeric(!!sym(dt_var))),
           !!bin_var_lab := ifelse(is.na(!!sym(bin_var_lab)), 0, !!sym(bin_var_lab))) %>% 
    select(all_of(c(fu_var_lab, bin_var_lab)))
}
```

Apply function

```{r}
dt_cols <- 
  df_fu_full %>%
  select(matches("anytime|25")) %>% # All outcome columns have 25 in the name
  colnames()

df_fus <-
  tibble(dt_col = dt_cols) %>% 
  mutate(fu_data = map(dt_col, calculate_fu))
```

Combine into one data set

```{r}
df_fus_wide <- 
  df_fus %>% 
  pull("fu_data") %>% 
  reduce(bind_cols)

# Join with baseline data
df_all_fus <-
  df_sel %>%
  bind_cols(df_fus_wide) %>% 
  mutate(fu_start = as.numeric(dt_loss),,
         across(starts_with("fu_"), ~. - fu_start)) # Make sure follow-up starts at birth for everyone
```

### Create dummy variable for age of parental death
with ages 18-20 as reference

```{r}
df_exposure_cat <-
  df_all_fus %>% 
  mutate(age_loss_cat = round(age_loss),
         age_loss_cat = ifelse(age_loss_cat %in% c(18, 19, 20), 18, age_loss_cat),
         age_loss_cat = as_factor(age_loss_cat),
         age_loss_cat = fct_relevel(age_loss_cat, "18")) %>% 
  filter(!c(lopnr %in% lopnr_died_before_parents))
```

### Calculate variable for pre-existing mental illness

```{r}
df_first_visit <-
  df_visits_all %>% 
  drop_na(dt_psy) %>%  
  slice_min(dt_psy, 
            by = LopNR, 
            with_ties = F)

df_preexist <-
  df_exposure_cat %>% 
  left_join(df_first_visit %>%  select(lopnr = LopNR, dt_psy)) %>% 
  mutate(preexist_diag = dt_psy < dt_loss,
         preexist_diag = ifelse(is.na(preexist_diag), F, preexist_diag)) %>% 
  select(-dt_psy)
```


### Extra dataset for descriptives

Contains only the binary indicators and sociodemographics

```{r}
df_descr <-
  df_preexist %>% 
  mutate(follow_up_years = fu_anypsy_anytime_all/365.25) %>% 
  select(lopnr, which_parent, preexist_diag, follow_up_years, matches("is_.+_anytime_all")) %>% 
  left_join(df_excl %>%
            select(lopnr = LopNR,
                   fam_link = fmlink,
                   age_loss, sex, birth_country, residency_region,
                   income, edu, psy_family, psy_history),
            by = "lopnr") 
```

```{r}
df_loss <- 
  read_rds("data_out/df_fu_analysis.rds") %>% 
  left_join(df_sel %>% select(lopnr, unnatural_death),
            by = "lopnr")
```


```{r}
write_rds(df_preexist, "data_out/df_fu_analysis.rds")
write_rds(df_descr, "data_out/df_descriptives.rds")
```
